verdict.rationale: The story asks about managing (listing/deleting) passkeys stored on the physical key itself and knowing its resident-credential capacity — a real, well-known FIDO2 concern (keys have finite resident-key slots). The evidence only covers removing a key from a Google *account* (docs-9) or unpairing Bluetooth pairing (docs-10/19/23), not managing credentials stored on the key's own memory, and never mentions credential capacity or an on-device credential manager/tool. No vendor CLI/tool is documented (google-titan-probe-rt-1 confirms no vendor CLI/SDK exists beyond Workspace Admin console, which manages account-level keys, not on-key credentials).
